fixes.why: CDCP requires a dated complete periodontal chart within 12 months for crown preauthorizations.

clause.ref: Restorative services — Complete perio chart <=12mo: Yes, crowns only (footnote 7)
clause.quote: If a complete perio chart is not available, a dated PSR for each sextant plus 6-site periodontal measurements for each tooth requested, within last 12 months, will be considered.
